message: The laptop from ORD-1055 won't turn on at all. I want a full refund.

evidence.sql: SELECT order_id, customer_id, order_date, delivery_date, product_name, category, unit_price, quantity, order_total, payment_method, status, final_sale FROM lightning.metastore.refundwise.refundwise_usl.orders WHERE customer_id = 'C011' AND order_id = 'ORD-1055'
SELECT refund_id, customer_id, order_id, request_date, amount, reason, decision FROM lightning.metastore.refundwise.refundwise_usl.refund_history WHERE customer_id = 'C011'
SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.refundwise.refundwise_usl.refund_policy WHERE category = 'Electronics' OR category = 'ALL'

rows.rule_text: Unused items may be returned for a full refund within 30 days of delivery.
Electronics change-of-mind returns are accepted only within 15 days of delivery and must be unopened.
Items that arrive damaged or defective are refunded in full within 30 days of delivery; a photo is requested.
If an order has not been delivered 14 days after the order date, the customer may choose a refund or a replacement.
Items marked final sale cannot be refunded unless they are defective.
Any refund above 200.00 must be reviewed by a support lead before approval.
Customers with 3 or more refunds in the last 90 days are sent to human review to check for abuse.
An order can be refunded only once. Requests for an order that was already refunded are rejected.
When the customer's claim conflicts with order or carrier records, the case goes to human review.

proposed_decision.rationale: The laptop is defective and delivered 10 days ago, within R3's 30-day defective window (E1, E2). However, the order total is $1249.00, which exceeds the $200.00 auto-approve limit, so R7 requires a support lead to review before approval (checks.over_auto_limit = true). The order is not final sale, not already refunded, and has no prior refunds in the last 90 days.

critique.reason: Order total exceeds the 200.00 auto-approve limit.

hard_guard.reason: Order total exceeds the 200.00 auto-approve limit.

customer_reply: I'm sorry to hear your 14in Ultrabook Laptop won't turn on. I've confirmed that your order ORD-1055 was delivered on October 15, 2026, and falls within our defective-item window. Because the order total is $1,249.00, a support lead will review your request before it can be approved. They will contact you with next steps.
limitations: Could not independently verify the physical condition of the laptop beyond the customer's report.
No photo of the defective laptop was provided for review.
